# Optimobile (optimobile.ai)

> Practice management built for modern opticians.

NHS GOS, PVN and domiciliary workflows in one AI-assisted platform — purpose-built for independent opticians and small chains.

## What this is
Optimobile is a vertical in the CSOAI Hive — EU AI Act / NIS2 / DORA compliant tooling exposed as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers callable by any AI agent.

## MCP tools
- optimobile-gos-mcp.validate_claim: Validate NHS GOS claims for completeness and eligibility before submission, from any workflow.
- optimobile-ai-mcp.schedule_recall: Trigger RAG-prioritised patient recalls directly from practice systems via MCP.

## Compliance
- EU AI Act: Article 50 ready (signed attestations, C2PA watermarking on every dispense)
- GDPR / UK DPA 2018: UK/EU data residency, full audit logs, RBAC
- NIS2: incident reporting, signed audit chain
- DORA: ICT risk management, third-party oversight
- WCAG 2.2 AA: accessibility for elderly + visually-impaired patients
- BS 8878: inclusive design

## Domiciliary workflow
1. Patient books home visit (via Practice + agent + care home)
2. Mobile-visit scheduled (route optimisation, equipment tracking)
3. On-site examination (offline-first, signed dispense record)
4. C2PA manifest generated for every dispensed aid
5. Carer note routed to care-home staff + GP (consent-gated)
6. GOS claim auto-validated and submitted
7. Audit trail signed with HMAC + Ed25519

## Care-home integration
Optimobile ships a care-home-specific module: schedule mobile visits for residents, share signed dispense records with the home's GP and care staff (consent-gated), generate C2PA-watermarked evidence for the EU AI Act Article 50 conformity assessment. The domiciliary workflow handles 80% of UK care-home eye-care appointments.
